body:
People - OCTOBER 16, 2026

RCLCO Fund Advisors (RFA) has appointed Shawn Veldhouse managing director. He will be based in the firm’s New York City office. Before joining RFA, Veldhouse served as deputy director of real estate investments at the New York State Common Retirement Fund, where he deployed capital for the fund’s discretionary investment programs. Previously, he worked for a family office and investment managers including The Milestone Group and RREEF.

RFA is the institutional real estate advisory and investment management affiliate of RCLCO Real Estate Consulting.

p: RCLCO Fund Advisors (RFA)가 Shawn Veldhouse를 매니징 디렉터로 임명했다. 그는 뉴욕시 사무소에 상주할 예정이다. RFA에 합류하기 전, Veldhouse는 New York State Common Retirement Fund에서 부동산 투자 부국장을 역임하며 펀드의 재량적 투자 프로그램을 위해 자금을 집행했다. 이전에 그는 패밀리 오피스와 The Milestone Group, RREEF 등의 운용사에서 근무했다.
RFA는 RCLCO Real Estate Consulting의 기관 부동산 자문 및 투자 운용 계열사이다.
